title: Indian banks put hard numbers on AI gains
takeaways: 10% to 50%: AI gains in productivity, turnaround and cost.
About 60% of Axis Bank collection calls handled by AI bots.
30% cut in HDFC Bank service turnaround times last quarter.
Only 21% of surveyed financial entities use or build AI.
95% of lenders rank AI cyber threats a top-3 risk.
source_note: Sources: Elets BFSI; NewsBytes; RBI FREE-AI report; RBI FSR June 2026
